title: Camping
text: “Ugh…”
Filolial-sama… It had been half a day since we set out aboard Yuki, Kou, and Sakura. Our journey to Siltvelt was proceeding smoothly.
“Are you okay, Ms. Éclair?”

We’d just stopped at a riverbank and started setting up camp. However, Éclair and the messenger from Siltvelt had gotten motion sickness from the cart and were completely down. The ride on Filolial-sama’s carriage is like a dream… I can see why one would get sick. I’m sure they’re experiencing sensations that transcend even the boundaries of the world.
“I just can’t fathom how Lord Iwatani and Lord Kitamura can remain so unfazed by this swaying… Ugh…”
Éclair is groaning something, but I can’t quite make it out. Filolial-sama’s swaying is, so to speak, a symbol of happiness. To feel sick means you’re intoxicated by Filolial-sama herself. HAHAHA.
“I’ve always been good with motion sickness, you know…”
After checking our surroundings, it seems there are no pursuers for now. Well, I don’t think those lowlifes could possibly keep up with Filolial-sama anyway.
“Well then, we’ll be camping here tonight.”
“Yeah. Should I handle the cooking?”
“In that case, I’ll convert the cart into a horse-drawn carriage.”
We’ll let Éclair and the others sleep on the riverbank, build a campfire, and then get to work.
“Gua-gua”

Yuki-chan and the others are playing energetically on the riverbank. At first, they watched me start modifying the cart with great interest, but I suppose they’ve gotten bored. It’s a heartwarming sight.
“Do this part like this~”
My father, in high spirits, started simmering something in a pot. A pleasant aroma wafted through the air, and Yuki-chan and the others, intrigued, came closer.
“You mustn’t disturb your father while he’s working, you know?”
“Gua!”
Yuki-chan and the others, barking energetically, are drooling and waiting impatiently. They must be hungry.
“Are these little ones going to eat too?”
“Yes, they are. Filolial-sama is an omnivore, so he’ll eat anything.”
“Huh… Well, then, I guess I’ll have to make more, won’t I?”

Saying that, my father took out the monster meat he’d loaded onto the cart and began butchering it. Oh! He seems to be getting the hang of it—I’m starting to see traces of the father I know in his movements.
“There were some herbs among the ingredients Motoyasu-kun prepared, and some things that could be used for medicine or as seasonings…”
My father deftly rubbed spices into the meat and began tying it up with string. I wonder what he’s making?
“There are actually quite a few steps involved, you know. The flavor won’t be quite as good, but… oh well.”
He’s arranged stones like a hearth and lit a fire underneath to smoke the meat. Is this… Smoked Meat?
“It’s pretty rough, but it’s good for preservation, right?”
“Gua!”
Yuki-chan and the others seemed to be nodding in agreement with Father’s words.
“As for the rest… Motoyasu, can you cut a rock horizontally? I’d like you to make it into a thin slab.”
“Got it.”

He used his spear to chop a large rock from the riverbank into a slab. Then Father used that slab to make a table… no, wait. He built a stone-grilling table. Underneath it, he lit another fire and started grilling the meat.
“I guess this will do for now?”
Lured by the aroma of the grilling meat, the Éclairs perked up and came running over.
“Motoyasu-kun prepared all sorts of things for us this time. We’ve used plenty of spices—try eating it with some salt.”
“Ooh!”
“Gwaaaah!”
Everyone started devouring the meal Father had prepared with great gusto.
“Iwatani-sama, you really do have a talent for cooking.”
“I just grilled some meat—it’s no big deal. “Though… this meat has quite a few tough, stringy parts, so it might be a bit hard to eat. I always think wild game is difficult to cook.”
“What? It’s way tastier than anything we’d make. I won’t complain.”

As we chatted like this, the day drew to a close. We took turns keeping watch, and as night fell… thinking that my Father must have spent nights like this before the loop, I can’t help but lament my own foolishness.
“Guaa…”
I’m fully aware that I’m grinning from ear to ear as I pet Yuki and the others. As expected, Filolial-sama is truly a supreme being. Just her presence brings happiness…
“These little ones… they’re making cracking sounds every time they move. Are they okay?”
“No problem at all. Those are the sounds of growth.”
“You mean they’re still growing!?”
Éclair, who had just been about to take a nap, sat up and asked. Why is she so surprised, ruminating on something so obvious?
“That’s right. These little ones will continue to grow from here on out.”
“That’s not the Filolial I know…”
“When raised by a hero, they develop in a special way.”
“I-is that so…”
Éclair, unable to hide her surprise, lay back down again.
“Lately, I’ve started to think that nothing is too strange to happen…”

My father muttered as he stroked Sakura-chan. It’s not that strange at all. Filolial-sama is about to undergo a magnificent evolution into an angel—what a joyous occasion. However… it seems Sakura-chan has really taken a liking to my father. It’s truly heartwarming. Hahahahahaha!
“Guh.”

Sakura-chan rested her head on my father-in-law’s lap—where he was sitting—and began to snore softly. My father-in-law was gently stroking her head. Did the father-in-law I knew ever treat Filolial-sama and the others like this? My memories of the future are full of gaps, but perhaps it did happen. I wonder… I remember him stroking something with great joy… but I just can’t quite recall what it was. I’m pretty sure it was my Big Sister… probably Filolial-sama! My memory is hazy, but I can’t imagine anyone else besides Filolial-sama being there.
“These kids are going to pull the carriage again tomorrow, right? Do your best.”
“Gua… Gua…” Father speaks gently to Sakura-chan.
“Speaking of which, I think it would be best if you and Yuki-chan went out to level up tomorrow.”
“Power-leveling, huh? Is it okay to do that here?”
“Since no pursuers have shown up, I don’t think there’ll be any problems.”
“I see…”
“I hope you’ll do your best alongside Yuki-chan and the others.”
“According to Motoyasu-kun, it sounds like our levels will rise at an incredible speed—it’s kind of scary.”
“Hahaha, Yuki-chan and the others have reached the level cap, so they’ll use the power of the Hero’s Weapon to increase their latent potential in exchange for their level.”
“I see—so it’s a base boost. Besides, it looks like it’ll be a while before we can do Class Up.”
“Who knows? We might be able to do it in one of the countries we stop by.”
“That’s true… Let’s keep our fingers crossed.”
Father smiled at Sakura-chan. Ah, Motoyasu here—for some reason, tears welled up at this sight. Filo-tan, where are you? Surely, you’re sleeping in an egg inside that monster merchant’s tent.

Once everything is settled… specifically, as soon as I’ve ensured the safety of my Father, I’ll rush right over. Please bear with me for a little while longer until then! And so, the night with Filolial-sama and the others came to an end.

The next morning. Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan, along with Éclair and one of the pigs, decided to accompany my father on his leveling run. Éclair rode on Yuki-chan’s back, while my father rode on Sakura-chan’s.
“Gua!”
“Hmm… you’ve gotten really big.”
“About 1.5 times the size of a normal Filolial… it feels pretty high up.”

The two muttered to themselves. The envoys from Siltvelt are helping us convert the cart into a carriage. We’ve secured enough materials, so it shouldn’t be a problem. Incidentally, it seems a hierarchy—or rather, an order of who takes the front line—has been established among the Filolial-sama. Yuki-chan, as the overall leader, is giving instructions to Kou and Sakura-chan. This time, with Yuki-chan leading the way, she’s entrusted Sakura-chan with guarding her Father—the very person they’re supposed to protect. This level of coordination just a few days after birth—truly, Filolial-sama is something else.
“Do your best!”
“Gua!”
When I encouraged Yuki-chan, she saluted as if to say she understood. Sakura-chan followed suit, but she’s being careful not to drop her Father.
“It’s Motoyasu-kun today. What are you going to do?”
“I’m going to make preparations for Filolial-sama.”
“Preparations? Is there still something else?”
“If all goes well, Filolial-sama will become an angel tonight.”
“Eh…? Is she going to die?”
My Father was speechless, his face filled with sadness.
